summary: Plan site-specific organic farms with practical mapping, soil, water and crop tools. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Organic farming and permaculture help intermediate-level farmers, farm advisers and rural development practitioners plan production around site conditions, resources and labour. The training develops skills in mapping farm sites, planning crop rotations and mixed plantings, and preparing soil-fertility, water-management and pest-monitoring plans. Participants also practise keeping field-trial and production records to review whether farm practices fit their conditions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who plan or manage organic production and need farm designs grounded in ecological conditions, available resources and day-to-day labour.
modules: Integrated Pest Management and Crop Health
prerequisites: Prior experience in farm production, farm advisory work or rural development practice is expected. No programming is required.
